3402 ResultOf<SNothing> Arithmetic(SExpr& Target)
3403 {
3404 // Prefix := .. | ('^' | '?' | .. | '+' | '-' | '*') Space (Brace | Prefix)
3405 SToken BaseToken = Cursor.Token;
3406 EatToken();
3407 return WhenBraceCall(
3408 BaseToken->Symbol, BaseToken->PrefixPrec, Target,
3409 [&](SBlockInternal& RightBlock) -> ResultOf<SNothing> {
3410 return UpdateFrom(
3411 Target, RightBlock.BlockTrailing,
3412 Gen.PrefixToken(SnipFinished(Target.Start, RightBlock),
3413 BaseToken->PrefixMode, BaseToken->Symbol,
3414 RightBlock,
3415 RightBlock.Punctuation == EPunctuation::Braces));
3416 });

3419 ResultOf<SNothing> LeftBracket(SExpr& Target)
3420 {
3421 // Prefix := .. | (.. | '[' List ']' | ..) Space (Brace | Prefix)
3422 SToken BaseToken = Cursor.Token;
3423 EatToken();
3424 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Left, List(u8"]", &CParser::S85, Cursor, CaptureType(),
3425 EPunctuation::None, Cursor));
3426 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(RequireClose(Target.Start, u8"[", u8"]", &CParser::S85));
3427 return WhenBraceCall(
3428 u8"[]", BaseToken->PrefixPrec, Target,
3429 [&](SBlockInternal& Right) -> ResultOf<SNothing> {
3430 return UpdateFrom(
3431 Target, Right.BlockTrailing,
3432 Gen.PrefixBrackets(SnipFinished(Target.Start, Right), Left,
3433 Right));
3434 });

3437 ResultOf<SNothing> If(SExpr& Target)
3438 {
3439 // If := "if" Key [Specs] (Paren (Block | Then) | Block [Then]) (Else |
3440 // !Else)
3441 Target.MarkupTag =
3442 u8"if"; // We propagate markup to support <if(a)>Hello</if>.
3443 EatToken();
3444 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(
3445 UpdateSpaceTrailing(Target, Gen.Native(Snip(Target.Start), u8"if")));
3446 SInvoke IfTarget{u8"if",
3447 Target,
3448 Target.Start,
3449 SToken(u8"if"),
3450 STokenSet{u8"then"},
3451 STokenSet{u8"else"}};
3452 return Invoke(IfTarget, Cursor);

3455 ResultOf<SNothing> ControlFlowKeyword(SExpr& Target)
3456 {
3457 // Def := .. | Return [KeyBlock|Def] StopDef
3458 SToken BaseToken = Cursor.Token;
3459 EatToken();
3460 SBlockInternal Right;
3461 Right.BlockTrailing.TrailingStart = Cursor;
3462 ULANG_GRAMMAR_SET(Right.BlockTrailing.TrailingCapture, Space());
3463 if (!StopDef.Has(Cursor.Token))
3464 ULANG_GRAMMAR_SET(Right, KeyBlock(EPrec::Def, Target,
3465 *Right.BlockTrailing.TrailingStart,
3466 CaptureType(), u8"",
3467 Right.BlockTrailing.TrailingCapture));
3468 return UpdateFrom(Target, Right.BlockTrailing,
3469 Gen.PrefixToken(SnipFinished(Target.Start, Right),
3470 BaseToken->PrefixMode, BaseToken->Symbol,
3471 Right, false));

3473
3474 ResultOf<SNothing> Base(SText What, EPrec Prec, SExpr& Target,
3475 ErrorType (CParser::*OnTokenError)(SText),
3476 ErrorType (CParser::*OnPrecError)(SText, SText))
3477 {
3478 // Base := '(' List ')' | Num | Char | Path | String | Markup | If |
3479 // !Reserved QualIdent
3480 ULANG_ASSERT(CheckToken());
3481 if (Prec > Cursor.Token->PrefixPrec)
3482 {
3483 return (Cursor.Token->PrefixPrec == EPrec::Never)
3484 ? (this->*OnTokenError)(What)
3485 : (this->*OnPrecError)(What, Cursor.Token->Symbol);
3486 }
3487 switch (uint8_t(Cursor.Token))
3488 {
3489 case SToken::Digit():
3490 {
3491 return UpdateSpaceTrailing(Target, Digit(Target));
3492 }
3493 case SToken(u8"\""):
3494 {
3495 return UpdateSpaceTrailing(Target, Quote(Target));
3496 }
3497 case SToken(u8"'"):
3498 {
3499 // CharLit := ''' Printable ''' !''' | ''' CharEsc '''
3500 return UpdateSpaceTrailing(Target, CharLit());
3501 }
3502 case SToken::Alpha(): // Ident.
3503 case SToken(u8"("): // QualIdent or Paren.
3504 case SToken(u8"at"):
3505 case SToken(
3506 u8"of"): // Infix operator tokens that are allowed as identifiers.
3507 case SToken(u8"to"):
3508 case SToken(u8"next"):
3509 case SToken(u8"over"):
3510 case SToken(u8"when"):
3511 case SToken(u8"while"):
3512 case SToken(u8"and"):
3513 case SToken(u8"or"):
3514 {
3515 return UpdateSpaceTrailing(
3516 Target, QualIdent(What, Target, /*AllowParenthesis*/ true));
3517 }
3518 case SToken(u8"@"):
3519 {
3520 return Attribute(What, Prec, Target);
3521 }
3522 case SToken(u8"<"):
3523 {
3524 return UpdateSpaceTrailing(Target, Markup());
3525 }
3526 case SToken(u8"/"):
3527 {
3528 return UpdateSpaceTrailing(Target, Path(Target));
3529 }
3530 case SToken(u8":"):
3531 case SToken(u8"in"):
3532 {
3533 return In(Target);
3534 }
3535 case SToken(u8"var"):
3536 case SToken(u8"set"):
3537 case SToken(u8"ref"):
3538 case SToken(u8"alias"):
3539 case SToken(u8"live"):
3540 {
3541 return VarKeyword(Target);
3542 }
3543 case SToken(u8".."):
3544 case SToken(u8"not"):
3545 {
3546 return Not(Target);
3547 }
3548 case SToken(u8"&"):
3549 {
3550 return Ampersand(Target);
3551 }
3552 case SToken(u8"^"):
3553 case SToken(u8"?"):
3554 case SToken(u8"+"):
3555 case SToken(u8"-"):
3556 case SToken(u8"*"):
3557 {
3558 return Arithmetic(Target);
3559 }
3560 case SToken(u8"["):
3561 {
3562 return LeftBracket(Target);
3563 }
3564 case SToken(u8"if"):
3565 {
3566 return If(Target);
3567 }
3568 case SToken(u8"return"):
3569 case SToken(u8"yield"):
3570 case SToken(u8"break"):
3571 case SToken(u8"continue"):
3572 {
3573 return ControlFlowKeyword(Target);
3574 }
3575 case SToken(u8"!"):
3576 {
3577 return S62();
3578 }
3579 default:
3580 { // Static analysis warnings without default
3581 break;
3582 }
3583 }
3584 ULANG_UNREACHABLE(); // Should never occur due to structure of the
3585 // precedence table.
3586 }

3588 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixBinaryOperator(const SToken PostfixToken,
3589 SExpr& Target)
3590 {
3591 // Mul := Prefix { Space ('*' | '/' | '&' ) Scan Prefix }
3592 // Add := Mul { Space ('+' | '-' ) Scan Mul }
3593 // To := Add [ Space ("to" Key | ".." | "->") Scan To ]
3594 // Choose := To [ Space ('|' ) Scan Choose ]
3595 // Greater := Choose [ Space ('>' | ">=" ) Scan Greater ]
3596 // Less := Greater [ Space ('<' | "<=" ) Scan &(Choose Space
3597 // !'>' !'>=') Less] NotEq := Less { Space ('<>' )
3598 // Scan Choose } Eq := NotEq { Space ('=' ) Scan
3599 // NotEq } And := Not { Space ("and" Key ) Scan And }
3600 // Or := And { Space ("or" Key ) Scan Or }
3601 Target.MarkupTag = u8"";
3602 EatToken();
3603 CaptureType Leading;
3604 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(Scan(Leading));
3605 return WhenExpr(
3606 PostfixToken->Symbol, PostfixToken->PostfixRightPrec(),
3607 PostfixToken->PostfixRightPrec(), &Target, Leading,
3608 [&](SExpr& Right) -> ResultOf<SNothing> {
3609 return UpdateFrom(Target, Right.Trailing,
3610 Gen.InfixToken(SnipFinished(Target.Start, Right),
3611 PostfixToken->PostfixMode,
3612 ApplyTrailing(Target),
3613 PostfixToken->Symbol, *Right));
3614 },
3615 PostfixToken->PostfixAllowMask);
3616 }

3618 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixRef(const SToken PostfixToken, SExpr& Target)

3620 // Call := Base {Space Postfix}
3621 // Postfix := .. | ('^' | '?' | "ref" | ..)
3622 Target.MarkupTag = u8"";
3623 EatToken();
3624 return UpdateSpaceTrailing(
3625 Target, Gen.PostfixToken(Snip(Target.Start), PostfixToken->PostfixMode,
3626 ApplyTrailing(Target), PostfixToken->Symbol));

3629 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixLeftBracket(const SCursor& PostfixStart,
3630 SExpr& Target)
3631 {
3632 // Call := Base {Space Postfix}
3633 // Postfix := .. | (.. | '[' List ']' ..)

3637 EPunctuation::Brackets, Cursor));
3638 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(RequireClose(Target.Start, u8"[", u8"]", &CParser::S83));
3639 Block0.BlockSnippet = Snip(PostfixStart);
3640 return UpdateSpaceTrailing(Target,
3641 Gen.Call(Snip(Target.Start), EMode::Closed,
3642 ApplyTrailing(Target), Block0));
3643 }

3645 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixAttribute(const SToken PostfixToken,
3646 SExpr& Target)
3647 {
3648 // Expr := Fun {'@' Space Call} StopExpr | ..
3649 EatToken();
3650 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Leading, Space());

3652 Leading, [&](SExpr& Right) -> ResultOf<SNothing> {

3660 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixAtOf(const SCursor& PostfixStart,
3661 const SToken PostfixToken, SExpr& Target)
3662 {
3663 // Postfix := .. | ("at"|"of") Key (KeyBlock | Fun)
3664 Target.MarkupTag = u8"";
3665 EatToken();
3666 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(PunctuationLeading, Space());
3667 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Right,
3668 KeyBlock(EPrec::Fun, Target, PostfixStart, CaptureType(),
3669 PostfixToken->Symbol, PunctuationLeading));
3670 return UpdateFrom(Target, Right.BlockTrailing,
3671 Gen.Call(SnipFinished(Target.Start, Right),
3672 PostfixToken->PostfixMode, ApplyTrailing(Target),
3673 Right));
3674 }
3675
3676 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixArrow(const SToken PostfixToken, SExpr& Target)
3677 {
3678 // Def := .. { .. | Space ":=" Space (BraceInd | Def) | ..} | ..
3679 // Fun := Def {Space ("=>" Space | "next" Key) (BraceInd | Fun) } StopFun
3680 EatToken();
3681 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Right,
3682 BraceInd(PostfixToken->Symbol,
3683 PostfixToken->PostfixRightPrec(), Target));
3684 return UpdateFrom(Target, Right.BlockTrailing,
3685 Gen.InfixBlock(SnipFinished(Target.Start, Right),
3686 ApplyTrailing(Target),
3687 PostfixToken->Symbol, Right));
3688 }
3689
3690 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixDotBlock(CaptureType& TokenLeading,
3691 const SToken PostfixToken, SExpr& Target)
3692 {
3693 // Postfix := .. | (.. | ScanKey '.' QualIdent)
3694 Target.MarkupTag = u8"";
3695 EatToken();
3696 Gen.CaptureAppend(Target.Trailing.TrailingCapture, TokenLeading);
3697 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Id, QualIdent(u8".", Target, false));
3698 return UpdateSpaceTrailing(
3699 Target,
3700 Gen.InfixToken(Snip(Target.Start), PostfixToken->PostfixMode,
3701 ApplyTrailing(Target), PostfixToken->Symbol, Id));
3702 }
3703
3704 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixIs(const SCursor& PostfixStart,
3705 CaptureType& TokenLeading, SExpr& Target)
3706 {
3707 // Def := .. (.. | ScanKey "is" Key (KeyBlock | Def) | ..)
3708 EatToken();
3709 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(PunctuationLeading, Space());
3710 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Right,
3711 KeyBlock(EPrec::Def, Target, PostfixStart, TokenLeading,
3712 u8"is", PunctuationLeading));
3713 return UpdateFrom(Target, Right.BlockTrailing,
3714 Gen.InfixBlock(SnipFinished(Target.Start, Right),
3715 ApplyTrailing(Target), u8"is", Right));
3716 }
3717
3718 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixWhere(const SCursor& PostfixStart,
3719 CaptureType& TokenLeading,
3720 const SToken PostfixToken, SExpr& Target)
3721 {
3722 // Def := .. (.. | Space "where" Key (KeyBlock | Defs) | ..)
3723 // Fun := Def { Space ('over' | 'upon' | 'while') Key (KeyBlock | Defs) |
3724 // ..) StopFun
3725 EatToken();
3726 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Right, KeyBlockDefs(Target, PostfixStart, TokenLeading,
3727 PostfixToken->Symbol));
3728 return UpdateFrom(Target, Right.BlockTrailing,
3729 Gen.InfixBlock(SnipFinished(Target.Start, Right),
3730 ApplyTrailing(Target),
3731 PostfixToken->Symbol, Right));
3732 }
3733
3734 ResultOf<SNothing> PostfixMacroInvoke(const SCursor& PostfixStart,
3735 CaptureType& TokenLeading,
3736 const SToken PostfixToken, EPrec Prec,
3737 SExpr& Target)
3738 {
3739 // Invoke := [Specs] (Paren [Specs] (Block | Do) | Block [[Specs] Do])
3740 // (Until | !Until) Def := (Or | ..) {&In Def | ..}
3741 SInvoke InvokeTarget{
3742 u8"macro invocation", Target,
3743 Target.Start, SToken::None(),
3744 STokenSet{u8"do"},
3745 STokenSet{u8"until", u8"catch"}
3746 };
3747 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(Invoke(InvokeTarget, PostfixStart, TokenLeading));
3748 if (Cursor.Pos == PostfixStart.Pos && InPrefixes.Has(PostfixToken))
3749 {
3750 if (Prec > EPrec::Def)
3751 {
3752 Cursor = PostfixStart; // backtrack NewLine's ScanToken
3753 return Target.OnFinish(*this);
3754 }
3755 // Parse Def and TGenerate a tokenless definition of Target.
3756 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(
3757 WhenExpr(PostfixToken->Symbol, EPrec::Def, EPrec::Def, &Target,
3758 CaptureType(), [&](SExpr& InExpr) {
3759 auto InBlock = SingletonBlock(InExpr.Start, InExpr);
3760 return UpdateFrom(
3761 Target, InBlock.BlockTrailing,
3762 Gen.InfixBlock(SnipFinished(Target.Start, InExpr),
3763 ApplyTrailing(Target), u8"", InBlock));
3764 }));
3765 }
3766 return SNothing{};
3767 }
3768
3769 ResultOf<SNothing> Postfix(
3770 SText /*What*/, EPrec Prec, SExpr& Target,
3771 ErrorType (CParser::* /*OnTokenError*/)(SText) = &CParser::S71,
3772 ErrorType (CParser::* /*OnPrecError*/)(SText, SText) = &CParser::S60)
3773 {
3774 while (!Target.Finished)
3775 {
3776 SCursor PostfixStart = Cursor;
3777 CaptureType TokenLeading = {};
3778 SToken PostfixToken = Cursor.Token;
3779 token_leading_loop:
3780 ULANG_ASSERT(CheckToken());
3781 if (!(Prec <= PostfixToken->PostfixTokenPrec || (Target.MarkupStart && MarkupPostfixes.Has(PostfixToken))))
3782 {
3783 Cursor = PostfixStart; // backtrack NewLine's ScanToken
3784 return Target.OnFinish(*this);
3785 }
3786 if (!Target.AllowPostfixes.Has(
3787 Cursor.Token)) // Immediate error disallowing e.g. a<=b>c per
3788 // grammar.
3789 return S61(PostfixToken->Symbol);
3790 switch (uint8_t(Cursor.Token))
3791 {
3792 case SToken(u8"&"):
3793 {
3794 if (Cursor[1] == '&')
3795 return S62();
3796 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixBinaryOperator(PostfixToken, Target));
3797 continue;
3798 }
3799 case SToken(u8"|"):
3800 {
3801 if (Cursor[1] == '|')
3802 return S62();
3803 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixBinaryOperator(PostfixToken, Target));
3804 continue;
3805 }
3806 case SToken(u8">"):
3807 {
3808 if (Target.MarkupStart)
3809 goto markup_postfix;
3810 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixBinaryOperator(PostfixToken, Target));
3811 continue;
3812 }
3813 case SToken(u8"*"):
3814 case SToken(u8"/"):
3815 case SToken(u8"+"):
3816 case SToken(u8"-"):
3817 case SToken(u8"to"):
3818 case SToken(u8".."):
3819 case SToken(u8"->"):
3820 case SToken(u8">="):
3821 case SToken(u8"<="):
3822 case SToken(u8"<>"):
3823 case SToken(u8"="):
3824 case SToken(u8"and"):
3825 case SToken(u8"or"):
3826 {
3827 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixBinaryOperator(PostfixToken, Target));
3828 continue;
3829 }
3830 case SToken(u8"^"):
3831 case SToken(u8"?"):
3832 case SToken(u8"ref"):
3833 {
3834 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixRef(PostfixToken, Target));
3835 continue;
3836 }
3837 case SToken(u8"["):
3838 {
3839 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixLeftBracket(PostfixStart, Target));
3840 continue;
3841 }
3842 case SToken(u8"@"):
3843 {
3844 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixAttribute(PostfixToken, Target));
3845 continue;
3846 }
3847 case SToken(u8"at"):
3848 case SToken(u8"of"):
3849 {
3850 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixAtOf(PostfixStart, PostfixToken, Target));
3851 continue;
3852 }
3853 case SToken(u8"=>"):
3854 case SToken(u8":="):
3855 case SToken(u8"next"):
3856 {
3857 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixArrow(PostfixToken, Target));
3858 continue;
3859 }
3860 case SToken(u8"."):
3861 {
3862 if (!IsSpace(Cursor[1]) /*&& !IsEnding(Cursor[1])*/)
3863 {
3864 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(
3865 PostfixDotBlock(TokenLeading, PostfixToken, Target));
3866 continue;
3867 }
3868 [[fallthrough]]; // Else it's a macro invocation handled below.
3869 }
3870 case SToken(u8"{"):
3871 case SToken(u8":"):
3872 case SToken(u8"<"):
3873 case SToken(u8"("):
3874 case SToken(u8"in"):
3875 case SToken(u8"with"):
3876 case SToken(u8":>"):
3877 case SToken(u8";"):
3878 case SToken(u8","):
3879 markup_postfix:
3880 {
3881 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixMacroInvoke(PostfixStart, TokenLeading,
3882 PostfixToken, Prec, Target));
3883 continue;
3884 }
3885 case SToken(u8"is"):
3886 {
3887 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(PostfixIs(PostfixStart, TokenLeading, Target));
3888 continue;
3889 }
3890 case SToken(u8"over"):
3891 case SToken(u8"when"):
3892 case SToken(u8"where"):
3893 case SToken(u8"while"):
3894 {
3895 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(
3896 PostfixWhere(PostfixStart, TokenLeading, PostfixToken, Target));
3897 continue;
3898 }
3899 case SToken::NewLine():
3900 {
3901 ULANG_GRAMMAR_SET(
3902 PostfixToken,
3903 ScanKey(TokenLeading, STokenSet{u8"is", u8"with", u8"{", u8">",
3904 u8":>", u8".", u8",", u8";"}));
3905 goto token_leading_loop;
3906 }
3907 case SToken(u8"=="):
3908 {
3909 return S65();
3910 }
3911 case SToken(u8"+="):
3912 case SToken(u8"-="):
3913 case SToken(u8"*="):
3914 case SToken(u8"/="):
3915 {
3916 return S66(PostfixToken->Symbol);
3917 }
3918 default:
3919 {
3920 ULANG_UNREACHABLE(); // Should be unreachable due to precedence.
3921 }
3922 }
3923 }
3924 return SNothing{};
3925 }
3926 ResultOf<SExpr*> FinishExpr(SToken Token, EPrec FinishPrec,
3927 SExpr& SourceExpr)
3928 {
3929 // Preemptively finish and TGenerate syntax for all expressions tighter than
3930 // FinishPrec, producing an error if there is no expression at or looser
3931 // than FinishPrec.
3932 ULANG_ASSERT(FinishPrec >= EPrec::Def); // Vital because EPrec.Def and looser
3933 // don't handle preemptive finish.
3934 for (auto Expr = &SourceExpr; Expr; Expr = Expr->OuterExpr)
3935 {
3936 if (Expr->FinishPrec <= FinishPrec)
3937 if (Token == SToken::None() || Expr->AllowPostfixes.Has(Token))
3938 return Expr;
3939 Expr->ExprStop = true;
3940 if (!Expr->Finished)
3941 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(Expr->OnFinish(*this));
3942 }
3943 return nullptr;
3944 }
3945 template <class CallableType>
3946 struct SWhenExpr : SExpr
3947 {
3948 using ResultType = decltype((*(CallableType*)nullptr)(*(SExpr*)nullptr));
3949 CallableType _Func;
3950 ResultType Result;
3951 SWhenExpr(EPrec FinishPrec0, SExpr* OuterExpr0, STokenSet PostfixAllow0,
3952 const SCursor& Start0, const CaptureType& ExprLeading0,
3953 const CallableType& Callable0, SExpr* QualIdentTarget0 = nullptr)
3954 : SExpr(FinishPrec0, Start0, OuterExpr0, PostfixAllow0,
3955 QualIdentTarget0)
3956 , _Func(Callable0)
3957 {
3958 this->ExprLeading = ExprLeading0;
3959 }
3960 ResultOf<SNothing> Parse(CParser& Parser, SText What, EPrec ParsePrec,
3961 ErrorType (CParser::*OnTokenError)(SText),
3962 ErrorType (CParser::*OnPrecError)(SText, SText))
3963 {
3964 TScopedGuard ExprDepthGuard(Parser.ExprDepth, Parser.ExprDepth + 1);
3965 if (Parser.ExprDepth > VERSE_MAX_EXPR_DEPTH)
3966 return Parser.S99();
3967 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(
3968 Parser.Base(What, ParsePrec, *this, OnTokenError, OnPrecError));
3969 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(
3970 Parser.Postfix(What, ParsePrec, *this, OnTokenError, OnPrecError));
3971 ULANG_ASSERT(this->Finished);
3972 return SNothing{};
3973 }
3974 ResultOf<SNothing> OnFinish(CParser& Parser) override
3975 {
3976 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(SExpr::OnFinish(Parser));
3977 this->ExprSyntax = Parser.Gen.Leading(this->ExprLeading, **this);
3978 ULANG_GRAMMAR_SET(Result, _Func(*this));
3979 ULANG_ASSERT(!this->Trailing);
3980 return SNothing{};
3981 }
3982 };
3983 template <class CallableType>
3984 SWhenExpr(EPrec, SExpr*, STokenSet, const SCursor&, const CaptureType&,
3985 const CallableType&, SExpr* e = nullptr, bool b = false)
3986 -> SWhenExpr<CallableType>;
3987 template <class CallableType>
3988 typename SWhenExpr<CallableType>::ResultType
3989 WhenExpr(SText What, EPrec ParsePrec, EPrec FinishPrec, SExpr* OuterExpr,
3990 const CaptureType& ExprLeading, const CallableType& Func,
3991 STokenSet AllowPostfixes = AllTokens,
3992 ErrorType (CParser::*OnTokenError)(SText) = &CParser::S71,
3993 SExpr* QualIdentTarget0 = nullptr)
3994 {
3995 // Start parsing an expression which may be finished preemptively by
3996 // FinishExpr.
3997 auto Target = SWhenExpr(FinishPrec, OuterExpr, AllowPostfixes, Cursor,
3998 ExprLeading, Func, QualIdentTarget0);
3999 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(
4000 Target.Parse(*this, What, ParsePrec, OnTokenError, &CParser::S60));
4001 return Target.Result;
4002 }
4003 ResultOf<SyntaxType> MarkupExpr(SExpr* OuterMarkup, SCursor MarkupStart)
4004 {
4005 CaptureType Leading;
4006 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(Scan(Leading));
4007 if (Cursor[0] == '/')
4008 return S42();
4009 auto Expr = SWhenExpr(EPrec::Call, nullptr, AllTokens, Cursor, Leading,
4010 [&](SExpr& Expr) -> ResultOf<SNothing> {
4011 Expr.Trailing = STrailing{};
4012 return SNothing{};
4013 });
4014 Expr.MarkupStart = MarkupStart;
4015 Expr.OuterMarkup = OuterMarkup;
4016 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(Expr.Parse(*this, u8"markup", EPrec::Call, &CParser::S74,
4017 &CParser::S64));
4018 if (!Expr.MarkupFinished)
4019 return S41();
4020 return *Expr;
4021 }
4022
4023 // Separated expressions.
4024 ResultOf<SBlockInternal> Commas(SText What, EPrec Prec, SCursor Start,
4025 CaptureType& Leading,
4026 ErrorType (CParser::*OnTokenError)(SText))
4027 {
4028 // Commas := Expr {',' Scan Expr}
4029 SBlockInternal Block0;
4030 for (;;)
4031 {
4032 bool More = false;
4033 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(WhenExpr(
4034 What, Prec, Prec, nullptr, Leading,
4035 [&](SExpr& Expr) -> ResultOf<SNothing> {
4036 More = Eat(u8",");
4037 if (More)
4038 ApplyTrailing(Expr, true);
4039 else
4040 Block0.BlockSnippet = Snip(Start, *Expr.Trailing.TrailingStart),
4041 Block0.BlockTrailing.MoveFrom(Expr.Trailing);
4042 Leading = CaptureType();
4043 Gen.SyntaxesAppend(Block0.Elements, *Expr);
4044 return SNothing{};
4045 },
4046 AllTokens, OnTokenError));
4047 if (!More)
4048 return Block0;
4049 Block0.Form = EForm::Commas;
4050 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(Scan(Leading));
4051 }
4052 }
4053 ResultOf<SBlockInternal> List(SText What,
4054 ErrorType (CParser::*OnTokenError)(SText),
4055 SCursor BlockStart,
4056 const CaptureType& PunctuationLeading,
4057 EPunctuation Punctuation, SCursor CommasStart,
4058 const CaptureType& Leading = CaptureType())
4059 {
4060 // Separator := (';'|Ending) Scan
4061 // List := push; set LinePrefix=""; Scan [Commas {Separator Commas}
4062 // [Separator]]; pop
4063 auto SavedContext = Context;
4064 bool Some = false;
4065 Context.LinePrefix = false;
4066 auto ListBlock = SBlockInternal{};
4067 ListBlock.Form = EForm::List;
4068 ListBlock.PunctuationLeading = PunctuationLeading;
4069 ListBlock.Punctuation = Punctuation;
4070 ListBlock.ElementsTrailing = Leading;
4071 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(Scan(ListBlock.ElementsTrailing));
4072 if (!StopList.Has(Cursor.Token))
4073 for (;;)
4074 {
4075 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(CommasBlock,
4076 Commas(What, EPrec::Expr, CommasStart,
4077 ListBlock.ElementsTrailing, OnTokenError));
4078 ApplyTrailing(CommasBlock, Cursor);
4079 CommasBlock.BlockSnippet = Snip(CommasStart);
4080 bool More = false;
4081 if (Cursor.Token == SToken(u8";") || Ending())
4082 {
4083
4084 // Attribute Commas-STrailing [';'] Space &NewLine to CommasBlock,
4085 // following Scan to ListBlock.
4086 auto SemicolonStart = Cursor;
4087 if (Eat(u8";"))
4088 Gen.Semicolon(CommasBlock.ElementsTrailing, Snip(SemicolonStart));
4089 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(SemicolonTrailing, Space());
4090 Gen.CaptureAppend(CommasBlock.ElementsTrailing, SemicolonTrailing);
4091
4092 // Start parsing next list element.
4093 CommasBlock.BlockSnippet = Snip(CommasStart);
4094 CommasStart = Cursor;
4095 ULANG_GRAMMAR_RUN(Scan(ListBlock.ElementsTrailing));
4096 More = !StopList.Has(Cursor.Token);
4097 }
4098 if (More || Some)
4099 {
4100 // Multiple Semicolon or NewLine separated elements.
4101 Some = true;
4102 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(CommasSyntax, Gen.Parenthesis(CommasBlock));
4103 Gen.SyntaxesAppend(ListBlock.Elements, CommasSyntax);
4104 }
4105 else
4106 {
4107 // Single Commas SBlock.
4108 Gen.CaptureAppend(CommasBlock.ElementsTrailing,
4109 ListBlock.ElementsTrailing);
4110 ListBlock.Form = CommasBlock.Form;
4111 ListBlock.Elements = CommasBlock.Elements;
4112 ListBlock.ElementsTrailing = CommasBlock.ElementsTrailing;
4113 }
4114 if (!More)
4115 break;
4116 }
4117 if (StopList.Has(Cursor.Token))
4118 {
4119 Context = SavedContext;
4120 ListBlock.BlockSnippet = Snip(BlockStart);
4121 return ListBlock;
4122 }
4123 return S77();
4124 }
4125 ResultOf<SyntaxType> File()
4126 {
4127 // File := [0oEF 0oBB 0oBF] set Nest=true; set BlockInd=""; set LineInd="";
4128 // List Scan end
4129 if (uint8_t(Cursor[0]) == 0xEF)
4130 {
4131 if (uint8_t(Cursor[1]) == 0xBB && uint8_t(Cursor[2]) == 0xBF)
4132 Next(3);
4133 else
4134 return S01();
4135 }
4136 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Block0, List(u8"", &CParser::S70, Cursor, CaptureType(),
4137 EPunctuation::None, Cursor));
4138 return Gen.File(Block0);
4139 }
4140 ResultOf<SyntaxType> CheckResult(const ResultOf<SyntaxType>& Result)
4141 {
4142 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Syntax, Result);
4143 if (Cursor[0] != 0)
4144 return S70(u8"");
4145 if (uint64_t(Cursor.Pos - InputString) != InputLength)
4146 return S01();
4147 return Syntax;
4148 }
4149
4150 // Friends.
4151 template <class FriendGeneratorType>
4152 friend TResult<typename FriendGeneratorType::SyntaxType,
4153 typename FriendGeneratorType::ErrorType>
4154 File(FriendGeneratorType& Gen, uint64_t n, const char8_t* s, uint64_t Line);
4155};
4156
4157//--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4158// Default Generator Framework inheriting a user generator.
4159
4160template <class GeneratorType>
4161struct TGenerate : GeneratorType
4162{
4163 using SyntaxType = typename GeneratorType::SyntaxType;
4164 using SyntaxesType = typename GeneratorType::SyntaxesType;
4165 using ErrorType = typename GeneratorType::ErrorType;
4166 using CaptureType = typename GeneratorType::CaptureType;
4167 using SBlockInternal = SBlock<SyntaxesType, CaptureType>;
4168 template <class ResultValueType>
4169 using ResultOf = TResult<ResultValueType, ErrorType>;
4170
4171 // Passthrough constructor.
4172 template <class... ArgTypes>
4173 TGenerate(const ArgTypes&... Args)
4174 : GeneratorType(Args...) {}
4175
4176 // Default translators from concrete syntax callbacks to abstract syntax
4177 // callbacks.
4178 TResult<SyntaxType, ErrorType>
4179 Units(const SSnippet& Snippet, const SyntaxType& Num, SText Units) const
4180 {
4181 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(UnitsIdent,
4182 this->Ident(SSnippet{}, u8"units'", Units, u8"'"));
4183 SyntaxesType Parameters;
4184 this->SyntaxesAppend(Parameters, Num);
4185 return this->Call(Snippet, EMode::Open, UnitsIdent,
4186 SBlockInternal{Snippet, Parameters});
4187 }
4188 ResultOf<SyntaxType> Parenthesis(const SBlockInternal& Block) const
4189 {
4190 if (this->SyntaxesLength(Block.Elements) != 1)
4191 {
4192 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Macro, this->Native(SSnippet{}, u8"array"));
4193 return this->Invoke(Block.BlockSnippet, Macro, Block, nullptr, nullptr);
4194 }
4195 else
4196 return this->SyntaxesElement(Block.Elements, 0);
4197 }
4198 ResultOf<SyntaxType> StringInterpolate(const SSnippet& Snippet, EPlace Place,
4199 bool /*Brace*/,
4200 const SBlockInternal& Block) const
4201 {
4202 ULANG_ASSERT(Place == EPlace::String || Place == EPlace::Content);
4203 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(FunctionSyntax,
4204 this->Native(SSnippet{}, Place == EPlace::String
4205 ? u8"ToString"
4206 : u8"ToMarkup"));
4207 return this->Call(Snippet, EMode::Open, FunctionSyntax, Block);
4208 }
4209 ResultOf<SyntaxType> String(const SSnippet& Snippet,
4210 const SyntaxesType& Splices) const
4211 {
4212 if (this->SyntaxesLength(Splices) == 1)
4213 return this->SyntaxesElement(Splices, 0);
4214 if (this->SyntaxesLength(Splices) == 0)
4215 return this->Parenthesis(SBlockInternal{});
4216 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(FunctionSyntax,
4217 this->Native(SSnippet{}, u8"Concatenate"));
4218 return this->Call(Snippet, EMode::Open, FunctionSyntax,
4219 SBlockInternal{SSnippet{}, Splices, EForm::Commas});
4220 }
4221 ResultOf<SyntaxType> Content(const SSnippet& Snippet,
4222 const SyntaxesType& Splices) const
4223 {
4224 return String(Snippet, Splices);
4225 }
4226 ResultOf<SyntaxType> Contents(const SSnippet& Snippet,
4227 const CaptureType& /*Leading*/,
4228 const SyntaxesType& Splices) const
4229 {
4230 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Macro, this->Native(SSnippet{}, u8"array"));
4231 return this->Invoke(Snippet, Macro, SBlockInternal{SSnippet{}, Splices},
4232 nullptr, nullptr);
4233 }
4234 ResultOf<SyntaxType>
4235 InvokeMarkup(const SSnippet& Snippet, SText /*StartToken*/,
4236 const CaptureType& /*Leading*/, const SyntaxType& Macro,
4237 SBlockInternal* Clause, SBlockInternal* DoClause,
4238 const CaptureType& /*TokenLeading*/,
4239 const CaptureType& /*PreContent*/, const SyntaxType& Content,
4240 const CaptureType& /*PostContent*/) const
4241 {
4242 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(DefineMacro, this->Native(SSnippet{}, u8"operator':='"));
4243 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(ContentIdent,
4244 this->Ident(SSnippet{}, u8"Content", u8"", u8""));
4245 SBlockInternal DefineClause;
4246 this->SyntaxesAppend(DefineClause.Elements, ContentIdent);
4247 SBlockInternal DefineDoClause;
4248 this->SyntaxesAppend(DefineDoClause.Elements, Content);
4249 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(ContentSyntax,
4250 this->Invoke(SSnippet{}, DefineMacro, DefineClause,
4251 &DefineDoClause, nullptr));
4252 auto LastClause = !Clause ? SBlockInternal{}
4253 : DoClause ? *DoClause
4254 : *Clause;
4255 this->SyntaxesAppend(LastClause.Elements, ContentSyntax);
4256 return this->Invoke(Snippet, Macro, !DoClause ? LastClause : *Clause,
4257 DoClause ? &LastClause : nullptr, nullptr);
4258 }
4259 ResultOf<SyntaxType>
4260 PrefixToken(const SSnippet& Snippet, EMode Mode, SText Symbol,
4261 const SBlockInternal& Block, bool Lift,
4262 const SyntaxesType& /*VarAttributes*/ = {}) const
4263 {
4264 if (Symbol == u8"in")
4265 Symbol = u8":";
4266 if (Lift)
4267 return this->Err(Snippet, "S98", "Feature is not currently supported");
4268 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Macro, /*IsAlnum(Symbol[0])?
4269 this->Ident(SSnippet{},Symbol,u8"",u8""):*/
4270 this->Ident(SSnippet{}, u8"prefix'", Symbol, u8"'"));
4271 if (Mode == EMode::Open || Mode == EMode::Closed)
4272 return this->Call(Snippet, Mode, Macro, Block);
4273 else if (Mode == EMode::With)
4274 return this->Invoke(Snippet, Macro, Block, nullptr, nullptr);
4275 else
4276 ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
4277 }
4278 ResultOf<SyntaxType> PrefixBrackets(const SSnippet& Snippet,
4279 const SBlockInternal& Left,
4280 const SBlockInternal& Right) const
4281 {
4282 if (Right.Punctuation == EPunctuation::Braces)
4283 return this->Err(Snippet, "S98", "Feature is not currently supported");
4284 if (this->SyntaxesLength(Left.Elements) == 0)
4285 {
4286 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Macro,
4287 this->Ident(SSnippet{}, u8"prefix'[]'", u8"", u8""));
4288 return this->Call(Snippet, EMode::Closed, Macro, Right);
4289 }
4290 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Macro,
4291 this->Ident(SSnippet{}, u8"operator'[]'", u8"", u8""));
4292 SBlockInternal Parameters;
4293 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(LeftSyntax, this->Parenthesis(Left));
4294 this->SyntaxesAppend(Parameters.Elements, LeftSyntax);
4295 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(RightSyntax, this->Parenthesis(Right));
4296 this->SyntaxesAppend(Parameters.Elements, RightSyntax);
4297 Parameters.Form = EForm::Commas;
4298 return this->Call(Snippet, EMode::Closed, Macro, Parameters);
4299 }
4300 ResultOf<SyntaxType> PostfixToken(const SSnippet& Snippet, EMode Mode,
4301 const SyntaxType& Left,
4302 SText Symbol) const
4303 {
4304 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Macro,
4305 this->Ident(SSnippet{}, u8"operator'", Symbol, u8"'"));
4306 SBlockInternal Parameters;
4307 this->SyntaxesAppend(Parameters.Elements, Left);
4308 if (Mode == EMode::Open || Mode == EMode::Closed)
4309 return this->Call(Snippet, Mode, Macro, Parameters);
4310 else if (Mode == EMode::With)
4311 return this->Invoke(Snippet, Macro, Parameters, nullptr, nullptr);
4312 else
4313 ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
4314 }
4315 ResultOf<SyntaxType> InfixToken(const SSnippet& Snippet, EMode Mode,
4316 const SyntaxType& Left, SText Symbol,
4317 const SyntaxType& Right) const
4318 {
4319 if (Symbol == u8"to")
4320 Symbol = u8"->";
4321 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Macro,
4322 this->Ident(SSnippet{}, u8"operator'", Symbol, u8"'"));
4323 SBlockInternal Parameters;
4324 this->SyntaxesAppend(Parameters.Elements, Left);
4325 this->SyntaxesAppend(Parameters.Elements, Right);
4326 if (Mode == EMode::Closed || Mode == EMode::Open)
4327 return Parameters.Form = EForm::Commas,
4328 this->Call(Snippet, Mode, Macro, Parameters);
4329 else if (Mode == EMode::With)
4330 return this->Invoke(Snippet, Macro, Parameters, nullptr, nullptr);
4331 else
4332 ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
4333 }
4334 ResultOf<SyntaxType> InfixBlock(const SSnippet& Snippet,
4335 const SyntaxType& LeftSyntax, SText Symbol,
4336 const SBlockInternal& Right) const
4337 {
4338 if (Symbol == u8"" || Symbol == u8"is" || Symbol == u8"=")
4339 Symbol = u8":=";
4340 SBlockInternal LeftBlock;
4341 this->SyntaxesAppend(LeftBlock.Elements, LeftSyntax);
4342 ULANG_GRAMMAR_LET(Macro,
4343 this->Ident(SSnippet{}, u8"operator'", Symbol, u8"'"));
4344 return this->Invoke(Snippet, Macro, LeftBlock, &Right, nullptr);
4345 }
4346 SyntaxType Leading(const CaptureType& /*Capture*/,
4347 const SyntaxType& Syntax) const
4348 {
4349 return Syntax;
4350 }
4351 SyntaxType Trailing(const SyntaxType& Syntax,
4352 const CaptureType& /*Capture*/) const
4353 {
4354 return Syntax;
4355 }
4356 TResult<SyntaxType, ErrorType> File(const SBlockInternal& Block) const
4357 {
4358 return Parenthesis(Block);
4359 }
4360
4361 // String callbacks that can contribute to abstract syntax.
4362 // In all string callbacks, every non-empty Snippet's text span is guaranteed
4363 // to be inside the parser's input string.
4364 void Text(CaptureType& Capture, const SSnippet& Snippet, EPlace Place) const
4365 {
4366 if (Place == EPlace::Content || Place == EPlace::String)
4367 this->GeneratorType::Text(Capture, Snippet, Place);
4368 }
4369 void NewLine(CaptureType& Capture, const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/,
4370 EPlace Place) const
4371 {
4372 if (Place == EPlace::Content)
4373 {
4374 char8_t Char8 = '\n'; // We normalize markup NewLine to \n.
4375 SSnippet NewSnippet = {};
4376 NewSnippet.Text = SText{&Char8, &Char8 + 1};
4377 this->GeneratorType::Text(Capture, NewSnippet, Place);
4378 }
4379 }
4380 void StringBackslash(CaptureType& Capture, const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/,
4381 EPlace Place, char8_t Backslashed) const
4382 {
4383 if (Place == EPlace::Content || Place == EPlace::String)
4384 {
4385 // We pass through backslashed control characters as-is.
4386 char8_t Char8 = Backslashed == 'n' ? '\n'
4387 : Backslashed == 'r' ? '\r'
4388 : Backslashed == 't' ? '\t'
4389 : Backslashed;
4390 SSnippet NewSnippet = {};
4391 NewSnippet.Text = SText{&Char8, &Char8 + 1};
4392 this->GeneratorType::Text(Capture, NewSnippet, Place);
4393 }
4394 }
4395
4396 // Optional string callbacks which don't contribute to abstract syntax.
4397 void LineCmt(CaptureType& /*Capture*/, const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/,
4398 EPlace /*Place*/, const CaptureType& /*Comments*/) const {}
4399 void BlockCmt(CaptureType& /*Capture*/, const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/,
4400 EPlace /*Place*/, const CaptureType& /*Comments*/) const {}
4401 void IndCmt(CaptureType& /*Capture*/, const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/,
4402 EPlace /*Place*/, const CaptureType& /*Comments*/) const {}
4403 void Indent(CaptureType& /*Capture*/, const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/,
4404 EPlace /*Place*/) const {}
4405 void BlankLine(CaptureType& /*Capture*/, const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/,
4406 EPlace /*Place*/) const {}
4407 void Semicolon(CaptureType& /*Capture*/,
4408 const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/) const {}
4409 void MarkupTrim(CaptureType& Capture) const { Capture = CaptureType(); }
4410 void MarkupStart(CaptureType& /*Capture*/,
4411 const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/) const {}
4412 void MarkupTag(CaptureType& /*Capture*/,
4413 const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/) const {}
4414 void MarkupStop(CaptureType& /*Capture*/,
4415 const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/) const {}
4416 void LinePrefix(CaptureType& /*Capture*/,
4417 const SSnippet& /*Snippet*/) const {}
4418};

4422
4423template <class GeneratorType>
4424TResult<typename GeneratorType::SyntaxType, typename GeneratorType::ErrorType>
4425File(GeneratorType& Gen, uint64_t n, const char8_t* s, uint64_t Line = 1)
4426{
4427 auto Parser = CParser(Gen, n, s, Line);
4428 return Parser.CheckResult(Parser.File());
4429}
